name: dictation-stills
title: Dictate: hold, speak, let go
summary: Stills of the pill, rendered by Dictum's own code on Avalonia's headless platform (PillStillsTests): Windows Sandbox has no microphone, so a real dictation cannot be recorded there. An illustration of the indicator, not a recording.

slides.caption: Hold Right Ctrl and speak. The bar at the bottom of the screen says Recording.
Let go of the key when you have finished. Dictum turns your words into text.
Your words appear where your cursor was. The bar says how many.
